{{Youmay|the annual celebrations on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]|The [[Freedom Day]] celebrations}}
The '''Freedom of Naboo''' was an [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] celebration held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], on the edge of the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]], in remembrance of [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|the conflict]] during which the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] united against the invasion forces of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].
